connectorId.description: Must be greater than 0, as 0 is for the CP itself.

idTag.description: The identifier used by the local user. Max length 20.

meterStart.description: The meter value (in Wh) at the start of the transaction.

timestamp.description: The time the transaction started, MUST be valid ISO 8601.

reservationId.description: Optional: The ID of the reservation that this transaction fulfills.
